question: If 15 May 2001 is a Tuesday, then what will be the day of the week on 11 June 2013?
solution:
Given: **15 May 2001** was Tuesday.

Now,

2001 to 2013= 12 Years (9 Ordinary Year and 3 Leap Years).

And, In 12 Years = 3 Leap years and 9 Ordinary Years.

So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days,

And, 9 Ordinary Years have 9 odd days.

Total odd days = 6 + 9 = 15.

13 odd days → 15/7 = 2 week and 1 odd days.

then, 15 May 2013 will be Tuesday + 1 = **Wednesday.**

Now, the number of days between 15 May 2013 to 11 June 2013

= 16(May 2012) + 11(June 2012)= 27 days.

= 27 days →27/7 = 3 week 6 odd days 

So, **11 June 2013** will be Wednesday + 6 = **Tuesday**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
